title: fea.interface
summary: Create a typed RunMat FEA interface.
description: `fea.interface(id, primaryRegion, secondaryRegion, Name, Value, ...)` creates contact, fluid-structure, or conjugate heat-transfer interface data.
behaviors: Interface id and both region selectors are exact text values; `Kind` defaults to contact.
Finite real numeric fields accept all eight built-in integer classes and cross one host-only binary64 model-storage boundary after field and shape validation.

Contact fields are penalty stiffness scale, maximum penetration ratio, and friction coefficient; FSI fields are normal stiffness, damping ratio, and relaxation factor; CHT fields are thermal conductance, contact resistance, and relaxation factor.
Unknown fields, nonfinite values, nonscalar values, and resident numeric fields are rejected before object construction.

faqs.question: Does interface construction use the GPU?
faqs.answer: No. It creates host model data; backend execution occurs only in a later solve.
